title: Benaam
writer: Narendra Bedi, Jayant Dharmadhikari, Kader Khan
actors: Amitabh Bachchan, Moushumi Chatterjee, Satyendra Kapoor
plot: After helping a stabbing victim to the hospital, a man begins to receive anonymous threats. The only way to save his wife and child is to unravel the mystery of the killer's identity.
